📢 GSIDC Recruitment 2026 – Typist (4 Vacancies)

Goa State Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (GSIDC), Panaji, invites applications for 4 Typist posts on a contract basis.

📍 Location: Panaji, Goa
🎓 Qualification: Graduation in any discipline
⌨️ Typing Speed: 40 WPM
💼 Experience: 2–3 years in the relevant field
💰 Salary: ₹29,200 per month
📌 Other Requirements: Knowledge of Konkani, 15 years of residence in Goa, and knowledge of Marathi. Computer knowledge is desirable.

📅 Last Date to Apply: 21 October 2026

📄 Check the official notification, prescribed application format and complete details on www.gsidcltd.com

📧 Submit the completed application to: careers@gsidcltd.com
